title: Dark Matter: Your invisible universe
script:
The universe is mostly invisible.
85% of all matter is completely hidden.
We call it Dark Matter.
It doesn't absorb or emit light.
It doesn't even interact with normal matter.
Yet, its gravity dictates galaxy formation.
It warps light from distant stars.
Trillions of these particles are phasing through your body every second.
Scientists are building giant detectors deep underground.
They hope to catch a single interaction.
Unraveling dark matter redefines cosmic reality.
Its unseen presence dictates everything, making the universe mostly invisible.
comment: What if we could finally see dark matter?
